record.context_brief: Kikuchi spectral threshold in Tensor PCA
record.original_question: Fix even tensor order r and integer level ell with n much larger than ell and ell >= r/2. Let M(lambda) be the matrix indexed by ell-subsets I, J of [n], with entries M(lambda)_{I,J} = lambda + Z_{IΔJ} when |IΔJ| = r and 0 otherwise, where Z_S are independent N(0,1) variables for |S| = r. Let lambda^natural_{r,ell} be the eigenvalue pop-out threshold of M(lambda). Is it true that for each fixed r, one has n^{r/4} * lambda^natural_{r,ell} -> 0 as ell -> infinity (after taking n -> infinity)?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 9 (Kikuchi Spectral Threshold). ... Let λ♮_{r,ℓ} denote the threshold at which eigenvalues "pop-out" of the spectrum of M(λ) ... For fixed r, we have n^{r/4} λ♮_{r,ℓ} → 0 as ℓ → ∞ (note that this is after one has taken n → ∞).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Fix an even integer $r \geq 2$ and an integer $\ell \geq r/2$. For each subset $S \subseteq [n] := \{1,2,\dots,n\}$ with $|S| = r$, let $Z_S$ be independent standard Gaussian random variables, and let $\lambda \geq 0$ be a real parameter. Define the symmetric matrix $M(\lambda)$ whose rows and columns are indexed by the $\binom{n}{\ell}$ subsets of $[n]$ of size $\ell$ via
$$
M(\lambda)_{I,J} \;=\; \begin{cases} \lambda + Z_{I \triangle J}, & |I \triangle J| = r, \\ 0, & \text{otherwise,} \end{cases}
$$
where $I \triangle J$ denotes the symmetric difference. Let $\lambda^{\natural}_{r,\ell}(n)$ denote the eigenvalue pop-out threshold of $M(\lambda)$, i.e., the infimum of values $\lambda \geq 0$ such that the top eigenvalue of $M(\lambda)$ separates from the bulk of its spectrum (in the limit $n \to \infty$ with $\ell$ fixed), and write
$$
\lambda^{\natural}_{r,\ell} \;=\; \lim_{n \to \infty} \lambda^{\natural}_{r,\ell}(n)
$$
appropriately rescaled as the limiting threshold. Prove or disprove: for every fixed even integer $r$,
$$
\lim_{\ell \to \infty} \; n^{r/4}\, \lambda^{\natural}_{r,\ell} \;=\; 0,
$$
where the limit $n \to \infty$ is taken first.
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture (a reformulation of a conjecture of Wein–El Alaoui–Moore, 2019) is open in general. Partial results characterize the threshold $\lambda^{\natural}_{r,\ell}$ for even $r$ and $r/2 \leq \ell < 3r/4$ via work of Bandeira, Cipolloni, Schröder, and van Handel (2024), but the full $\ell \to \infty$ limiting statement has not been established.

status_evidence.title: Tensor PCA and the Kikuchi Algorithm (problem 9) | Randomstrasse 101
status_evidence.snippet: For even r and r/2 ≤ ℓ < 3r/4 the threshold has been characterized in recent work by Bandeira, Cipolloni, Schröder, and van Handel (2024).
status_evidence.claim: Stated as an open conjecture with partial characterization of the threshold for r/2 ≤ ℓ < 3r/4.

status_evidence.title: The Kikuchi Hierarchy and Tensor PCA
status_evidence.snippet: Wein, El Alaoui, Moore conjecture concerning the Kikuchi spectral threshold for Tensor PCA.
status_evidence.claim: Original conjecture source; open as of publication.
